name: two spins in one field, weighted observable
question: Does one frequency of the observable fix the amplitude of its signal?
assumptions: Closed unitary dynamics; hbar = 1; energies and rates in one arbitrary unit.
H = w (Z0 + Z1); the observable X0 (1 + a Z1) + b Z0 weights the transverse magnetization of the first spin by the orientation of the second, and is not a vector under the rotations that contain H.

provenance.origin: authored control for the closure of the observable (tutorial Chapter 24, Section 6)
